user.title: Connect to Xray API
user.description: Enter an Xray gRPC endpoint reachable over a trusted LAN or VPN. The default host is 192.168.1.1 and the default port is 10085.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Xray API endpoint
reconfigure.description: Update the endpoint, then choose which discovered outbounds to monitor.

outbounds.title: Select outbounds to monitor
outbounds.description: Only selected outbounds get entities. Leave the list empty to monitor none.

error.already_configured: This host and port are already configured.
error.invalid_port: Enter a TCP port from 1 to 65535.
error.timeout: The Xray API did not respond before the deadline.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Xray API endpoint.
error.unimplemented: The Xray build does not implement a required API service or method.
error.unknown: The Xray API validation failed. Check the endpoint and service configuration.

error.unimplemented: The Xray build does not implement the Routing service or method.
